subject: English
question_text: Complete the text adding prefixes, suffixes or both with the root words given in the parenthesis:
stimulus: 0.5 x 10=5 Everybody knows that (a) ____ (smoke) is a (b) ____ (danger) bad habit. It is (c) ____ (harm) to health. It is also (d) ____ (cost). A (e) ____ (smoke) should not smoke (f) ____ (public). Smoking creates (g) ____ (pollute). A single puff of cigarette contains (h) ____ (numerable) harmful particles that cause many (i) ____ (respirator) diseases which are incurable. But there are many people who are (j) ____ (aware) of the bad effects of smoking.
guide_solution: (a) smoking; (b) dangerous (c) harmful (d) costly (e) smoker (f) publicly (g) pollution (h) innumerable (i) respiratory (j) unaware
